verdict.rationale: Codegen provides some visibility into agent activity — CLI 'view agents' and traces (codegen-docs-12, codegen-docs-17), OpenTelemetry monitoring/logging for Claude Code runs (codegen-docs-21), and Slack progress reports (codegen-docs-2) — but there's no dedicated real-time dashboard or live status stream described. missing for 10: a first-party live/streaming dashboard showing current agent state, explicit 'current status' indicator, and independent hands-on confirmation of real-time monitoring UX.
